rules.label: Video ad slider and in-content ad

meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Songkick video ads, app prompts and artist sign-up; blur or hide artist photos; hide Track buttons and home carousels
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, iPhone UA 390x844 in headless Chrome, songkick.com home page. Counts are `querySelectorAll` on the rendered DOM saved from that load (scripts then switched off to evaluate): Primis video slider and in-content video-ad wrapper in the ads option, get-the-app band and the header app button in the app-banners option, artist/Tourbox links, artist/event/genre photos, Track and attendance buttons, and the four home rows (ids `homepage-*-carousel` plus `section.genre-carousel`). Selectors are readable BEM class names and ids from Songkick's own markup, not hashed classes, and none depend on English text.

Photos are a Show/Blur/Hide choice; Hide removes only the image so names and dates stay. NOT verified: artist pages, concert detail and venue pages, search, the metro-area page, desktop layout, signed-in states, and the original cookie rules (no consent banner appeared for this session).
